text: Carol Jennings said 'we need this faster.' That's not yet something anyone can build against -- this video turns it into a real number.
Real-time, to the second, was never actually the need -- Derek only checks the data twice a day. The real ceiling is the source system itself: the last stores' nightly exports land around 1am.

The signed-off requirement: from the moment a file lands in cloud storage, it must be visible in the Gold models within 30 minutes, every night -- verified against 10 consecutive nights of timestamps.
Thirty minutes beats a two-day wait regardless -- and because the pipeline reacts continuously to whatever lands, it won't need a redesign if Pinehurst's exports ever get more frequent.
Next: drawing a hard line around what version one actually delivers, before forecasting quietly creeps into scope.
